text: This report recommends that the name "Henry Box Brown Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of St Paul Street, extending southerly of North Star Way. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/legdocs/mmis/2022/ex/bgrd/backgroundfile-228155.pdf This naming proposal is in alignment with the objectives of the Guiding Principles for Commemoration in the Public Realm.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name “Henry Box Brown Lane” for an existing public lane located east of St Paul Street, extending southerly of North Star Way.
